item.title: Talenti introduces two new flavors
item.description: Chocolate Hazelnut Crunch Gelato and Paradise Passionfruit Sorbetto are new additions to Talenti's ice cream and sorbetto lineup.

item.title: Agropur posts $8.9B in 2025 revenues
item.description: The results represent 2% growth compared to 2024.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's parent company announces first earnings results
item.description: The Magnum Ice Cream Co.'s fiscal year 2025 earnings came in 7.9 billion euros (approximately $9.38 million U.S. dollars), +4.2% organic sales growth (OSG) year-on-year, with volume growth +1.5% and price growth +2.6%. Operating Profit was 599 million euros, (approximately $711 million U.S. dollars).

item.title: The protein power of cottage cheese, yogurt fuels Olympic and FIFA World Cup athletes
item.description: With the 2026 Winter Olympics taking place this month and the upcoming FIFA World Cup, cultured dairy is playing an important part in athletes' training and recovery. Protein-packed products are in high demand.

item.title: Dairy Farmers of America to receive up to $46M grant from USDA
item.description: This grant is especially meaningful for small farms, many of which are interested in conservation practices and can benefit from additional resources to make implementation more accessible.

item.title: Amcor polypropylene beverage cups qualify as “Widely Recyclable”
item.description: This milestone reflects years of industry collaboration to align packaging design, recycling infrastructure, end markets and consumer guidance.

item.title: Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams continues to see new avenues for growth
item.description: Jeni’s Splendid Ice Cream has grown steadily and is on track to reach over $150 million in 2025 revenue. Originating in Columbus, Ohio, it is now a nationally recognized brand.

item.title: Blue Diamond Growers introduces new line: Blue Diamond Almondmilk
item.description: As a grower-owned cooperative with more than a century of almond-growing expertise, Blue Diamond Growers introduced Blue Diamond Almondmilk with simple ingredients in four flavors.

item.title: Validating cleaning performance in dairy processing equipment
item.description: Cleaning and sanitizing dairy processing equipment is a complex task influenced by the nature of dairy products, intricate equipment designs, strict regulatory standards (FSMA, PMO), and environmental conditions. Inadequate sanitation can lead to product recalls and outbreaks, especially when manual cleaning is required for dry systems or equipment with complex internal geometries, such as heat exchangers.

item.title: Cultured dairy holds the key to proper GLP-1 diets
item.description: A quick look at the composition of some cultured dairy products shows that they are well designed for GLP-1 diets. High-protein yogurts, including skyr and Greek yogurt, are the first products that comes to mind.
